Verses.VerseEn: Ha, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۛ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By this Light-Giving Book,

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ فِىۡ لَيۡلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ‌ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنۡذِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We have sent it down in a blessed night. Surely We are the Warner.

Verses.VerseAr: فِيۡهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ اَمۡرٍ حَكِيۡمٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In this (night) judgment is given on all matters of wisdom (separately),

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡرًا مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا‌ؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By Our Command; surely it is We Who send.

Verses.VerseAr: رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It) is Mercy from your Lord. Verily He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing,

Verses.VerseAr: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا‌ۘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, provided you have faith with certitude.

Verses.VerseAr: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡىٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ‌ؕ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ اٰبَآٮِٕكُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is no God but He. He is the One Who gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your fathers (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِىۡ شَكٍّ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Yet they are in doubt, busy playing.

Verses.VerseAr: فَارۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَاۡتِىۡ السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So wait for the Day when the sky will cause a clear smoke to appear,

Verses.VerseAr: يَغۡشَى النَّاسَ‌ؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Which will envelop people (i.e. will encompass everything). That will be a painful torment.

Verses.VerseAr: رَّبَّنَا اكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا الۡعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They will then say:) ‘O our Lord! Remove this torment from us. Surely we believe.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَنّٰى لَهُمُ الذِّكۡرٰى وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How can their accepting the admonition now be (of any use) whereas there came to them a Messenger with clear exposition?

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡا عَنۡهُ وَقَالُوۡا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجۡنُوۡنٌ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But they turned their faces from him and (denigrating) they said: ‘(He) is an educated madman.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوۡا الۡعَذَابِ قَلِيۡلاً‌ اِنَّكُمۡ عَآٮِٕدُوۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed We remove the torment a little (but) you will certainly start reiterating (the same disbelief).

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ الۡبَطۡشَةَ الۡكُبۡرٰى‌ۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when We will seize with the Greatest Seizure, (that Day) We shall certainly exact revenge.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ كَرِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in fact We put to trial the people of Pharaoh (also) before them and the exalted Messenger (Musa [Moses]) came to them.

Verses.VerseAr: اَنۡ اَدُّوۡۤا اِلَىَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنِّىۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ اَمِيۡنٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He said:) ‘Hand over to me the servants of Allah (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily I am a trusted Messenger for your guidance and leadership.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡ لَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَى اللّٰهِ‌ۚ اِنِّىۡۤ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And do not rebel against Allah. I have come to you with the enlightening proof.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنِّىۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّىۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ اَنۡ تَرۡجُمُوۡنِۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I have indeed sought the protection of my Lord and your Lord lest you should stone me.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا لِىۡ فَاعۡتَزِلُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you do not believe in me then keep away from me.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ مُّجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he prayed to his Lord: ‘Surely they are a sinful people.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِىۡ لَيۡلاً اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah said:) ‘Then set out with My servants by night. You shall certainly be chased.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتۡرُكِ الۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًا‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (after you pass through) leave the river still and split open. Surely they are an army who will be drowned.’

Verses.VerseAr: كَمۡ تَرَكُوۡا مِنۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How many a garden and spring they left behind!

Verses.VerseAr: وَّزُرُوۡعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيۡمٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And green crops and magnificent buildings!

Verses.VerseAr: وَّنَعۡمَةٍ كَانُوۡا فِيۡهَا فٰكِهِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And blessings (and comforts) in which they used to luxuriate!

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ‌ وَاَوۡرَثۡنٰهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So it happened! We made another people the inheritors of all that.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡظَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then neither the heaven nor the earth wept over them, nor were they given respite.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرآءِيۡلَ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُهِيۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily We delivered the Children of Israel from a humiliating suffering,

Verses.VerseAr: مِنۡ فِرۡعَوۡنَ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: From Pharaoh. Indeed he was of the most rebellious transgressors.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدِ اخۡتَرۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰى عِلۡمٍ عَلَى الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We chose them (the Children of Israel) above (the contemporary civilizations of) the world on the basis of knowledge.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيۡهِ بَلٰٓؤٌا مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We bestowed upon them Signs containing an obvious favour (and a clear trial).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely they say:

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هِىَ اِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا الۡاُوۡلٰى وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنۡشَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: ‘There is nothing after our first death and we will not be raised up (again).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآٮِٕنَاۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So bring back our ancestors (alive) if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ‌ؕ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ‌ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, are they better or the people of Tubba‘ (the people of As‘ad Abu Kurib al-Hamiri, the King of Yemen) and those who were before them? We destroyed (all of) them. Surely they were people given to evildoing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them merely in sport.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا خَلَقۡنٰهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We have created them both with (the purpose and reason) of Truth. But most of them do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡفَصۡلِ مِيۡقَاتُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the Day of Judgment is the appointed time for all of them;

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِىۡ مَوۡلًى عَنۡ مَّوۡلًى شَيْئًا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when a friend shall not avail a friend at all, nor will they be helped,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except those to whom Allah has shown Mercy. (They will intercede for one another.) Surely He is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوۡمِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed the tree bearing thorny fruit,

Verses.VerseAr: طَعَامُ الۡاَثِيۡمِۛۚ ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Will be the food of the major sinners.

Verses.VerseAr: كَالۡمُهۡلِ ۛۚ يَغۡلِىۡ فِىۡ الۡبُطُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It will boil in the bellies like molten copper,

Verses.VerseAr: كَغَلۡىِ الۡحَمِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Like the seething of simmering water.

Verses.VerseAr: خُذُوۡهُ فَاعۡتِلُوۡهُ اِلٰى سَوَآءِ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be commanded:) ‘Seize him and drag him forcefully to the midst of Hell,

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ صُبُّوۡا فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِهٖ مِنۡ عَذَابِ الۡحَمِيۡمِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then torment him by pouring boiling water over his head.

Verses.VerseAr: ذُقۡ ۖۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡكَرِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Taste it! Yes, you it is the respectable and venerable (in your notion and claim).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَمۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Certainly this is the very Hell you used to doubt.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ مَقَامٍ اَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly the Godfearing will be in a place of calm and peace,

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Amid gardens and springs,

Verses.VerseAr: يَّلۡبَسُوۡنَ مِنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَۚ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Dressed in fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So will it happen! And We will marry them to fair maidens having lovely wide eyes.

Verses.VerseAr: يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Sitting) there, they will call calmly for every kind of fruit.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا الۡمَوۡتَ اِلَّا الۡمَوۡتَةَ الۡاُوۡلٰى‌ ۚ وَوَقٰٮهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There (in Paradise) they will not taste death except the first death (which would have passed). And Allah will save them from the torment of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: فَضۡلاً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is a Bounty of your Lord (i.e. your Lord will bestow through your mediation alone). That is but a great success.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We have made this (Qur’an) easy in your own tongue so that they may take advice.

Verses.VerseAr: فَارۡتَقِبۡ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّرۡتَقِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (do) wait. Certainly they (too) are waiting. (You will see the revenge and their evil end and they will see your glory and My favours to the believers through your mediation.)
